title: Grocery EDI for Snack Brands: Keep Case Counts and Advance Ship Notices Consistent
summary: Build each grocery advance ship notice in Orderful from the NetSuite shipment record so a 96-case first truck is never reported as the full 120-case order.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


For snack-brand grocery EDI, carry the retailer item and case definition from the purchase order through the actual shipment. Build the advance ship notice from warehouse evidence, including the partner-required carton or pallet relationships, rather than copying ordered quantities. Validate item, unit, location, and partial-shipment rules before transmission.


Explore the complete[packaged food and snacks integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/packaged-food-snacks) for the systems and processes around this guide.
